item.title: Solarmax 24V/50M Lift Submersible Solar Water Pump
item.dc:creator: toptechtools
item.content:encoded:
Product details

The Solar-Powered direct water pump Kit is conveniently powered by energy from sunlight, no external batteries or electricity needed. The solar water pump has a Water output of 1500 L/Hr,  can  do  50 Metres pull depths ( Best for up to 150 feet well/borehole). OTHER FEATURES:

  • Can pump water from a river at 2000 l/hr with fairly sloppy area for 3 kilometres
  • No need for battery and solar controller
  • Can work with solar panels only ( 2 panels of 150 watts)
  • Can pump water from fairly sloppy area to  3 Kilometers
  • Horse pump 1.5 hp
  • Does not need a controller
  • Should NOT be used with inverter
  • Can go dry without damage i.e no need for float switch
  • Product has a life span of 15-20Years
  • Solar-powered submersible pump suitable for wells and boreholes 4 inch diameter or larger.
  • No need for solar charge controller, i.e. connect the two wires of the pump directly to solar panel.
  • No need for float switch. The pump can run dry without damage. Profile
  • This pump is best for small/Medium sale use i.e where water requirement is between 10,000  to 15,000 litres per day.
  • Very good for irrigation.
